name: Signara
description: Signara turns your data into verified, deterministic KPIs, drivers, and recommendations. Every number is computed by a deterministic engine (no AI guessing), and each figure comes with proof. Connect a database (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MySQL) and Signara pulls the data server-side, or paste data directly. Ask what changed and why, get lever-targeted recommendations, verify your own write-ups against the source, and save recurring analyses as reusable skills you can re-run anytime.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Signara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Signara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-auth.getsignara.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Signara MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signara lists 14 MCP tools, including analyze, analyze_connection, ask, delete_skill, explain, get_metrics, list_analyses, list_connections, list_skills, recommend, run_skill, and save_skill.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Signara?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Signara in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Signara requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Signara is developed by SenseForge Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
